name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Crispy edges, chewy centers, and plenty of chocolate chips — the cookie that started it all.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Combine flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat butter and both sugars until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Gradually blend in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 9–11 minutes until golden brown. Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.

name: Sourdough Country Loaf
description: A rustic, open-crumbed sourdough with a crackly crust and mild tang.
instructions: Mix flours and 600g water; rest 30–60 minutes (autolyse).
Add starter and remaining water. Mix until incorporated.
Add salt; perform 4 sets of stretch-and-folds, 30 minutes apart.
Bulk ferment 3–4 hours at room temperature until dough rises ~30%.
Shape into a boule, proof in a banneton 12–16 hours in the fridge.
Preheat Dutch oven to 500°F. Score and bake covered 20 min, uncovered 20–25 min.

name: Banana Bread
description: Moist, warmly spiced banana bread — perfect for overripe bananas.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9×5 inch loaf pan.
Mix mashed bananas with melted butter.
Stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over mixture; stir.
Add flour and cinnamon; mix until just combined.
Pour into pan and bake 55–65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Fudgy Brownies
description: Dense, fudgy brownies with a shiny crackled top and deep chocolate flavor.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9×13 pan with parchment.
Melt butter; whisk in sugar, then eggs one at a time.
Stir in cocoa, flour, salt, and vanilla until just combined.
Fold in walnuts if using.
Spread in pan and bake 25–30 minutes. Cool completely before cutting.

name: Lemon Pound Cake
description: A buttery, tender pound cake with bright lemon glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and flour a bundt pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time.
Alternate adding dry ingredients and buttermilk. Fold in lemon zest.
Pour into pan; bake 55–65 minutes until golden and a tester comes out clean.
Whisk lemon juice with powdered sugar for glaze. Drizzle over cooled cake.

name: Cinnamon Rolls
description: Soft, fluffy rolls swirled with cinnamon sugar and topped with cream cheese frosting.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. Add warm milk, melted butter, and eggs; knead 8–10 minutes.
Let rise 1–2 hours until doubled.
Roll dough into an 18×12 inch rectangle. Spread butter, sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll tightly, slice into 12 rolls. Place in a greased 9×13 pan; rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes until golden.
Beat cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla for frosting. Spread over warm rolls.

name: French Macarons
description: Delicate almond meringue shells with a smooth, crisp exterior and chewy interior.
instructions: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar twice.
Whip egg whites to soft peaks; gradually add granulated sugar to stiff peaks.
Fold in dry ingredients and color until batter flows like lava.
Pipe 1½ inch rounds on parchment; rest 30–60 minutes until skin forms.
Bake at 300°F for 14–16 minutes. Cool completely.
Pair shells by size; pipe filling and sandwich.

name: Blueberry Muffins
description: Tall, bakery-style muffins bursting with fresh blueberries.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk milk, oil, egg, and vanilla in a separate bowl.
Fold wet into dry until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
Divide batter among cups; sprinkle with turbinado sugar.
Bake 20–25 minutes until tops are golden and a tester comes out clean.

name: Apple Pie
description: A flaky double-crust pie filled with spiced, tender apple slices.
ingredients: 6 cups peeled, sliced Granny Smith apples
instructions: Make crust: cut butter into flour and salt until pea-sized. Add ice water until dough holds together. Chill 1 hour.
Toss apples with sugar, flour, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Roll bottom crust; fit into 9-inch pie plate. Add filling; dot with butter.
Roll top crust; place over filling. Crimp edges; cut vents. Brush with egg wash.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes, then 350°F for 45–55 minutes until golden.

name: Croissants
description: Buttery, laminated croissants with dozens of flaky layers.
instructions: Mix flour, salt, sugar, yeast, and milk into a smooth dough. Chill 1 hour.
Roll butter into a flat block between parchment.
Encase butter in dough; perform 3 single folds with 30-minute rests between.
Roll to 4mm thick; cut triangles and roll into crescent shapes.
Proof 2 hours until puffy. Brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F for 15–18 minutes until deeply golden.
